verses.text: "Look, I am sending my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will come to his temple; the messenger of the covenant, the one you desire, will come," says the LORD of Armies.
But who can endure the day of his coming? Who can stand when he appears? For he will be like a fire that refines metal or like strong soap that cleans clothes.
He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; he will purify the Levites and refine them like gold and silver. Then they will bring offerings to the LORD in the right way.
And the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to the LORD, as in days gone by, as in former years.

"So I will come to put you on trial. I will be quick to speak as a witness against sorcerers, adulterers, and liars, against those who cheat workers of their wages, who oppress widows and orphans, and who refuse to help foreigners and do not respect me," says the LORD of Armies.
"I the LORD do not change. So you, the descendants of Jacob, are not destroyed.

Ever since the time of your ancestors you have turned away from my rules and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you," says the LORD of Armies. "But you ask, 'How are we to return?'
Will a mere human rob God? Yet you rob me. But you ask, 'How are we robbing you?' In tithes and offerings.
You are under a curse — your whole nation — because you are robbing me.

Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in my house. Test me in this," says the LORD of Armies, "and see if I will not throw open the windows of heaven and pour out so much blessing that there will not be room enough to store it.
I will stop the pests from eating your crops, and the vines in your fields will not drop their fruit before it is ripe," says the LORD of Armies.
"Then all the nations will call you blessed, for yours will be a delightful land," says the LORD of Armies.
"You have spoken harsh words against me," says the LORD. "Yet you ask, 'What have we said against you?'
You have said, 'It is useless to serve God. What do we gain by following his rules and by going about as mourners before the LORD of Armies?
But now we call the arrogant blessed. Even those who do evil prosper. They even test God and get away with it.'"
Then those who respected the LORD talked with each other, and the LORD listened and heard. A scroll of remembrance was written in his presence about those who respected the LORD and honored his name.
"On the day when I act," says the LORD of Armies, "they will be my treasured possession. I will spare them, just as a father spares his son who serves him.
And you will again see the difference between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not."
